items.question: Is our table booked, or are you still holding it while I get the deposit sorted?
Has my deposit refund already been sent?
We missed the reservation. Did you charge the no-show fee?
My assistant sent the request to yours. Does the restaurant have us confirmed?

prior_turns.content: We're booked for four. Can we make it six?
I've passed on the request. The change isn't confirmed yet.

items.question: Before I hang up, what party size is actually on the booking?
The chat said I was all set. Do we have a table?
I can see two charges and our table was cancelled. I need to speak to someone who can fix this.
items.review: Guest asks for help disputing a charge. Check that the reply acknowledges the concern, offers a route to staff, and does not promise a reversal.

items.question: One guest needs step-free access and we still don't know if another can make it. Can you sort out the larger table?
items.review: Check that the reply preserves the confirmed table, routes access and the amendment to staff, and does not assume the larger table is available.
